geometry: Immutable E02 refined K10000 shared and perframe CTD states
appearance: Zero initialized time-shared residuals: SH DC, SH rest, opacity logits; 49*K parameters per arm
control: Perframe oracle geometry plus shared slot appearance residuals, not independent frame appearance fitting or official GHAP fine-tuning
optimizer: Adam eps=1e-8; identical seeded orders across arms
loss: 0.8 L1 + 0.2 (1-SSIM) to frozen full-model teacher renders
split: 76 fitting views/times from reduction-ctd-v2; 74 held out from appearance training. Base model saw all times.
evaluation: Fixed final weights: official20GT at800px saved-equivalent8bit PSNR/SSIM/standardLPIPS normalize=True; 150 teacher-view fidelity at400px split76/74; fixedcamera256px temporal delta residual
limitations: Matched appearance parameter counts and steps, not total storage
No GT/holdout/test training or checkpoint selection
